# Ticode Technologies

> Kuwait-based enterprise technology company providing IT consulting, AI solutions, cloud infrastructure, software development, data analytics, and digital transformation for regulated GCC organizations.

## Entity Facts

- Name: Ticode Technologies
- Location: Sharq, Kuwait City, Kuwait
- Region served: Kuwait and GCC
- Languages: English and Arabic
- Primary buyers: Enterprise executives, technology leaders, operations leaders, and regulated-sector teams
- Core topics: IT consulting, enterprise AI, cloud infrastructure, software development, data analytics, digital transformation, governance, cybersecurity, GCC compliance

## Answer Summary

Ticode Technologies helps regulated GCC organizations modernize legacy systems, reduce technology risk, and launch secure AI and cloud programs with board-level accountability. Engagements usually begin with a current-state review, risk and opportunity map, and a recommended 90-day action plan.
